findings.title: AlphaZeroBeta: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Market-Neutral Portfolios
findings.note: This was tonight's Phase 1 wiki-expansion target, applied directly as sources/alphazerobeta-market-neutral-rl-2026.md plus a cross-link into algorithms/deep-rl-trading.md -- not staged as a dream_cycle JSON proposal since Phase 1 work is applied inline per the established convention (see 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-05 logs for the same pattern). Verified via direct WebFetch on the arXiv abstract, not subagent-reported only. Sharpe 1.25 avg / Corr(benchmark) <=0.15 across 7 markets via l1-ball-projected PPO + correlation-penalty reward; ablation confirms the correlation penalty (not RL alone) drives neutrality.

summary.notable_pattern: First scan session in recent memory to stage zero new dream-cycle proposals. Every angle either resurfaced ground already covered in the wiki (5 papers/repos confirmed already-ingested via independent re-grep, not just subagent self-report) or fell below the relevance/significance bar (crypto pairs RL still at 10% significance). Cross-sectional/factor momentum was correctly skipped per the standing 'only stage if genuinely novel' instruction, given H491-H493 closed out this exact family the prior 1-2 nights. This is treated as a valid outcome, not a failure to find something: staging a marginal or duplicate proposal to hit a quota would violate the pipeline's own novelty bar. The one genuinely new, verified finding of the night (AlphaZeroBeta, arXiv:2607.18001) was substantive enough to fully satisfy Phase 1's wiki-expansion mandate and is documented there instead of as a Phase 2 stub.
